# Single Go Binary Over Python

Ship the CLI as one static Go binary instead of a Python script.

**Context:**

The CLI is invoked many times per agent turn, so cold-start time and the absence of a runtime prerequisite matter more than implementation verbosity.

**Options:**

- A Python script (PEP 723, stdlib-only) needing a Python interpreter on PATH.
- A single static Go binary with no runtime prerequisite.

**Decision:**

Go binary.

**Consequences:**

- No runtime prerequisite anywhere it runs.
- The CLI source is more verbose to write than the equivalent Python.

**Affects:**

- [Intent](../README.md)
